entries.dialogueText: "The recession is still our number one concern. This year we have seen 10 percent decrease in our GDP. A shocking number."

entries.title: Symon Holl: ""Mr. Vice President was pretty on p..."

entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, unemployment has greatly declined. We have managed to cut it by almost sixty percent since we took office. It is currently projected to be 6.6 percent this year. A great achievement."

entries.title: Symon Holl: ""This downward trend has broken our..."
entries.dialogueText: "This downward trend has broken our economy over the last years. If we cannot contain this in time, we will end our term -- in the truest of sense of the word -- in a depression."

entries.dialogueText: "However, this has not yet reflected well with our debt situation. Our total national debt has increased about 25 billion SR this  year. If we enter a higher deficit over the next years we will face a massive debt crisis which could crash the economy."

entries.title: Symon Holl: ""On the other hand, unemployment ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, unemployment has declined. Projections display that we have managed to cut it by five percent, from 16 percent to 11."

entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, unemployment reports indicate that we achieved stability by avoiding an increase in joblessness. We are at 16 percent, the same number at the start of our term."
